stage_split_note: single last clip, timed in sequence after the warm loop; decode and detect are separate stages
note: Warm latency_ms is the value predict() reports and the one the evaluator scores. Cold start is one-time per process. If competing_distllm_processes > 0 the CPU was shared; re-run with --affinity to confirm.
note_two_runs: Two independent clean runs on 18 Nov, 0 competing distllm processes both times, give warm p50 577-749 ms and cold start 12.1-14.7 s. MediaPipe's lazy graph build dominates cold start and varies with machine state, so quote the range rather than either endpoint. The stage split is stable across both runs: detect is ~87% of a 32-frame pass, the nine-member classifier is ~0.5%.
